name: Sora (App & API)
description: A high-fidelity text-to-video model and platform. Shutdown following the collapse of a $1B Disney partnership and a strategic pivot to robotics research.

name: GPT-4o (ChatGPT)
description: The 'Omni' model that powered ChatGPT for nearly two years. Deprecated to consolidate users onto the GPT-5 foundational series.

name: Codex API
description: The specialized model series (including code-davinci-002) designed for translating natural language to code. Its sudden deprecation with only three days' notice forced developers to migrate to chat-based completion models.

name: o1-preview
description: A reasoning model designed for complex STEM tasks. Sunset after its 'thinking' capabilities were natively integrated into the GPT-5.1 release.
